Privacy policy

Last updated November 12, 2026

Agape brings food, drinks and gear to your seat at live events. This policy says what Agape collects, why, who sees it, and what you can do about it. We collect only what we need to run the service, and we never sell your information.

What we collect

  • Your account. The name you choose to show and a password. We store your password only as a one-way scrambled form (a hash) that can't be turned back into the password.
  • Where you're sitting. The venue, section, and, if you give them, row and seat, so a runner can find you. You type these in or scan a code at the venue. Agape does not track your location.
  • Your orders. What you ordered, from which stand, when, the price, tax, delivery fee and tip, and what happened to it (made, delivered, or put right).
  • Payments. When cards are connected, your card is handled by our payment processor. Agape never sees or stores your full card number. We keep a reference to each payment and its amount, so the books balance.
  • If you write to us. Through the contact form: your name, how to reach you, your organization if you give one, and your message.
  • If you work with Agape. Staff and runner accounts include the venue, role and shift times, and, for runners, the trips taken and what was earned.
  • Technical basics. Our server records the requests it receives, including the network address they came from, to keep the service secure and working. We don't use advertising trackers or sell data to anyone.

How it's used

  • To take, make and deliver your order, and to show you honestly when it will reach your seat.
  • To charge the right amount, pay the stands and runners what they're owed, and keep accurate books.
  • To put problems right: a missing or wrong order, a refund or a credit.
  • To keep Agape safe: preventing fraud, abuse and repeated false claims.
  • To answer you when you write to us.

Who sees it

  • The stand making your order sees what you ordered and when it's due.
  • The runner bringing it sees your first name, your seat, and what to hand you.
  • The venue's operations team sees orders and problems during the event, to run the night.
  • Our payment processor handles card payments under its own privacy policy.
  • Agape's team sees what it needs to support you, pay people, and keep the books.
  • We may disclose information if the law requires it. If Agape is ever sold or merged, this policy continues to apply to what we hold about you.

We don't sell personal information, and we don't share it with advertisers.

Partners and offers

Some venues offer deals from nearby businesses. If you unlock or use one, that business learns that an Agape fan did, and may see the name you show in Agape. It doesn't get your contact details from us.

How long we keep it

We keep your account while you use it. Order and payment records are kept as long as tax, accounting and payment rules require. Messages through the contact form are kept while we're in touch with you. Backups are deleted on a rolling schedule.

Your choices

  • You can ask us for a copy of your information, to correct it, or to delete your account. We'll do it unless we must keep a record by law (for example, a payment).
  • You can order without sharing a row or seat number; the runner will find you by your section, or you can pick up instead.
  • Your sign-in is stored on your own device so you stay signed in. Signing out removes it.

Security

Connections to Agape are encrypted, passwords are stored only as hashes, sign-in attempts are limited, and access by Agape's own team is limited to what each role needs and recorded. No system is perfectly secure; if something goes wrong that affects you, we'll tell you.

Children

Agape is not meant for children under 13, and we don't knowingly collect information from them. Items with age limits, such as alcohol, require proof of age when they're handed over.

Changes

If we change this policy, we'll update the date above, and tell you in the app if the change is significant.

Contact

Questions or requests about your information: write to us, and a person will answer.
